elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Section (c) applies upon expiry or termination of the Agreement or any Statement of Work for any reason and requires Contractor, at Company's request, to provide reasonable transition assistance.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: Section (c)(i) expressly provides for transition assistance for up to six (6) months.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: Section (c)(i) states that the assistance is provided at Contractor's then-current rates.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must return Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Section (c)(ii) requires Contractor to return all Works, Confidential Information, and other Company data and materials in its possession or control.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned within 30 days.
elements.evidence: Section (c)(ii) expressly requires return within thirty (30) days.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Section (c)(ii) requires return in a commonly used, machine-readable format, which substantively satisfies a standard machine-readable format.

elements.element: Vendor must delete Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: Section (c)(iii) requires Contractor thereafter to delete all returned data and materials from its systems.

elements.element: Vendor must certify deletion after deleting Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Section (c)(iii) requires Contractor to certify the deletion to Company in writing.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Section (c) applies upon expiry or termination and requires Contractor, at Company's request, to provide reasonable transition assistance.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for 90 days.
elements.evidence: The obligation to provide assistance for up to six months permits Company to request and receive at least a 90-day assistance period.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must export Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Section (c)(ii) requires Contractor to return Company data in a commonly used, machine-readable format, substantively providing a data export.

elements.element: Customer Data must be exported within 30 days.
elements.evidence: Section (c)(ii) expressly sets a thirty-day deadline for the data return/export.

result.reason: The operative language satisfies every preferred requirement and therefore also the fallback. It is not strictly minimal because it extends the return-and-deletion obligations beyond Customer Data to all Works, Confidential Information, and other Company materials, and also applies upon termination or expiry of any individual Statement of Work. These additions remain related to transition and do not contradict the existing termination, payment, or work-assignment provisions.
